label: Solve the balanced allocation equations for every feasible named share of work (inference)
rule: Construct a conserving allocation for each intermediate share and derive both bounds from the margins
meaning: Four nonnegative routing entries realize every integer in the specified interval. At a zero lower bound one can construct an allocation with no named input expended. At a positive lower bound every compatible allocation supplies an exercised contributor step to the combined work. Interpreting actual expenditure as productive remains an open application condition.
